notes.title: Thank You
notes.notes:
Thank you all for buying our first game. We have some major changes coming to Block Run throughout the year that we think you’re all going to love. Block Run will be coming out on Android devices in the upcoming months and on iOS and iPadOS by the end of the year. There will be some bug fixes for the game in the upcoming weeks and some new content. We also have a new game in development which will be released next year. 
Thank you for all the support and you will be seeing more from us soon.
